name: QuoteEditor
description: Static browser app: swap a QuoteMaker card's text into another language and re-export as JPG

paragraphs: A static, browser-only app for swapping a quote card's text into another language after the fact. Translators can either use the quotes already preloaded for the current/upcoming week, or upload their own recipe JSONs — whichever's convenient. Nothing is uploaded anywhere except through the password-protected admin page.

Companion project: QuoteMakerV3 generates the original English quote cards and, alongside each .jpg, exports a .json "recipe" file (the card's background image plus its font/size/color styling). This app opens that recipe, lets you replace the English text with another language, and re-exports the card as a JPG with the same look.
